visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a dimly lit concert stage where a young woman with dark bobbed hair, wearing a patterned black-and-white blouse and a tan pleated skirt, stands beside a young man in a white t-shirt and baggy dark trousers. Both hold microphones and engage in an active dialogue, their bodies angled toward each other under soft purple stage lights. Behind them, a massive purple screen glows with a large text overlay, while the foreground is filled with the dark silhouettes of a dense crowd holding up dozens of glowing smartphone screens to record the event. (2) As the man speaks and gestures towards the background, the large screen behind them suddenly shifts from a solid purple field to a high-contrast monochrome ultrasound image depicting a fetus. The woman’s expression transforms from casual listening to profound shock; her eyes widen, her mouth drops open, and she points emphatically at the screen with her free hand. The man smiles broadly, placing a reassuring arm around her shoulder while they both face the audience. The crowd in the foreground becomes more animated, with phones tilting and moving to capture the surprise revelation amidst the shifting stage illumination.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The recording begins with a male voice speaking through a high-amplification sound system in a large reverberant space. He speaks in Mandarin with a casual, mid-pitch tone, saying '也是第一次看到我們兩個合照...哎講錯了' (It's also the first time seeing the two of us... oops said it wrong). A female voice responds with a short, high-arousal affirmative sound. The background contains the low-frequency hum of a massive indoor venue and distant crowd murmurs. (2) At approximately nine seconds, a massive acoustic transition occurs. As the male voice mentions '第一次看到我們三個人一起合唱' (First time seeing the three of us singing together), the audio is suddenly flooded by an explosive surge of high-frequency energy. This consists of sustained, high-pitched female screams, loud percussive clapping, and broadband cheering. The intensity level jumps to maximum, nearly masking the male's continued speech. The spectral density is extremely high in the upper-mid frequencies, characterizing a high-valence, high-arousal collective emotional response from the audience.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a surprising and emotional pregnancy announcement during a live stage performance. It captures the authentic shock of a friend/colleague and the ecstatic reaction of the audience to create a heartwarming, viral-style social media moment.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video relies heavily on the emotional payoff of the ultrasound reveal. The low production editing suggests a raw, user-generated perspective from the audience.
